description:
Hi, 
 This is Raju. I am Recruiter at Randstad Technologies and I am reaching out in regards to your background. I have an exciting opportunity
  *Candidates MUST be able to work on W2 to qualify for this role.* 
 ​ 
 
 
 Job Title: Peoplesoft Integration Developer 
 Duration: 9 Months 
 Location: Pleasanton, CA 
 Job Description 6+ years of experience required

 On site required, some remote is acceptable

 12-month contract

 High School Diploma is required - BA/BS preferred or equivalent experienc

 Top Daily Responsibilities: 
 Sr. PeopleSoft Developer to work on implementing co-existence between PeopleSoft 9.1 and Oracle HCM cloud.

 Role includes: analyze existing/develop new PeopleSoft IB messaging, People Code, SQL, AE and CIs. 

 Role will involve design, build, testing, deployments, etc.

 Skills a Top Candidate Should Have: 
 PeopleSoft HCM 9.1 and above, Functional knowledge or HR, ePerformance, Compensation and Payroll modules.

 People Tools 8.54x and above

 People Code

 Application Engine

 Integration Broker

 Component Interfaces

 Web Service / IB

 DB2

 Extremely Proficient in SQL (preferably DB2)

 Knowledge of Java

 Support the design and creation of technical specifications from functional specifications for complex data conversion as well as mapping projects.

 Support the development of test scenarios, test cases, and correct data in critical situations as directed.

 Analyze the data impact of target system and programming solutions using the People Tools suite. [Oracle HCM Cloud knowledge is nice to have but not mandatory.] 

 Desired Skills: 
 Prior Experience with integration PeopleSoft with other ERP system is preferred.

 Oracle certifications a plus.

 Please have a look at the below job requirement and reply back to me with your latest word format resume ASAP. Do let me know the best contact number to reach you.  

 Note : If you feel this job description does not suit your profile then kindly let me know your preferred job roles so that I can be in touch with you with similar jobs and you can refer me a suitable person for this job as well. Hope to hear from you soon.


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
